custom_logic_notes: Hedging EA manages correlated positions across two symbols. Core logic involves: calculating net exposure between long/short legs, opening opposing positions to hedge directional risk, partial closing of hedge legs when combined profit targets are met, and rebalancing lot sizes to maintain desired hedge ratio. Position management is multi-symbol and requires tracking open positions across both instruments simultaneously.
python_conversion_notes: Hedging logic requires a position tracker that maintains state across two correlated symbols simultaneously. Net exposure and combined P&L calculations must be computed on every tick. Partial close functionality needs careful lot-size management. No indicators simplifies signal generation, but the multi-symbol position management and hedge ratio rebalancing add significant complexity. Must implement a position ledger that can query open positions by symbol and direction, compute aggregate exposure, and execute coordinated open/close across both legs.
